The sum of allocations across all container types *i* must meet the demand *dem[j-1]*. Currently the constraint only sums allocations *from* types *i* to type *j*, however, `alloc[i,j]` is defined such that it is only non-zero when `cap[i-1] >= cap[j-1]`.  This constraint will likely not ensure that demand is satisfied, since lower capacity containers cannot be used to satisfy the demand of containers with larger capacity. It has not accounted for the possibility that an earlier container could substitute for a later container. It should sum allocations of all containers into the demand `dem[j-1]`.
